title: Boundary Energy Density and Null Propagation in Global AdS$_3$/CFT$_2$
summary: We study how bulk propagation in global AdS$_3$ is reflected in boundary energy densities of the dual CFT$_2$ on the cylinder. A key feature of the global geometry, which is absent in the Poincaré-patch description, is that a null excitation emitted from the boundary reaches the antipodal boundary point after $Δτ=π$ and returns to the original boundary point after $Δτ=2π$.
